---
title: Carrots in Agro
id: MAR-0022
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 6
time_min: 40
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 500 g baby carrot
- 3 dl white wine
- 2 dl white wine vinegar
- 20 g parsley
- 7 basil leaves
- 5 mint leaves
- 1 sprig rosemary
- 1 bay leaf
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 tablespoon sugar
- 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Wash, scrape the carrots and cut them into four lengthwise pieces.
2. Pour half a liter of water, the wine and the vinegar into a saucepan, add the peeled garlic cloves, rosemary, parsley, bay leaf, mint, sugar, oil and the carrots; season with salt and pepper.
3. Cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes, until the carrots are cooked.
4. Drain the carrots and place them in a bowl, pour the strained liquid over them, finish with the basil leaves and let cool.
5. Cover and keep in the refrigerator for a few hours.
